slides.title: Court lets Addis Standard's case go ahead

slides.text: Addis Standard reports the **Federal High Court** rejected the **Media Authority's** objection and has **jurisdiction** over the case.
The outlet's online registration was **revoked in February**; its publisher says it got **no warning** and no reports were named.
The ruling does **not decide** whether the revocation was lawful. The next hearing is set for **Dec 9**.
**Protect press freedom, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica, Nov 16, 2026
